targetText: With the increase in population a number of sister gentes arose that again brought forth several daughter gentes.
summary: Bebel traces how the development of herding, agriculture, metalworking, and private property led men to overthrow maternal law (the 'world-historical defeat of the female sex') and establish patriarchy, paternal inheritance, and monogamous marriage designed to secure private property for male heirs.
